{"reason": "Adding a confidence gate: 6 of 8 false-arbitration rows have confidence < 0.7 (0.44-0.67), yet v1 arbitrates on them. Requiring (high-confidence? edi-change) prunes those low-confidence FPs to cut the 0.714 false-arbitration-rate while the >= 0.7 bar should preserve the needed arbitrations, keeping recall near the 0.8 gate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
